title: Offboard a customer and deliver an authorized data export
summary: When a customer cancels, expires or requests an agreed service exit. A verified service exit with reconciled billing, authorized data delivery and access and retention decisions recorded.
outcomes: A verified service exit with reconciled billing, authorized data delivery and access and retention decisions recorded.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a customer cancels, expires or requests an agreed service exit.

parts.title: Confirm the customer, contract and requested exit
parts.guidance: Verify the requester's authority, agreement, service dates and requested data. Separate service cancellation, account closure, a data-subject request and a billing dispute because they may follow different rules.

parts.title: Agree the exit and data-handling plan
parts.guidance: The account, privacy and contract owners confirm export scope, format, recipients, retention and deletion instructions. Resolve legal holds and third-party data rights before promising removal or disclosure.

parts.title: Prepare and validate the authorized export
parts.guidance: Assemble the approved customer data in a controlled workspace, checking completeness and tenant separation. Remove secrets and unrelated personal data and verify the delivery recipient through an independent approved route.

parts.title: Execute the approved service and access changes
parts.guidance: Authorized operators deliver the export, update subscription and billing status and revoke the specified integrations and access. Use the agreed timing and retain evidence of each action.

parts.title: Reconcile residual obligations and closure evidence
parts.guidance: Confirm final invoices, refunds, data receipt and completed or scheduled deletion. Record retained data and its basis with the privacy owner, and keep unresolved customer issues assigned.
